title: Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, …
content:
Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, build-eval and hillclimb guides (#1930)

* Update claude-api skill: Claude Opus 5.5 default, Claude Sonnet 5.5, build-eval and hillclimb guides

- Make Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) the default model across SKILL.md,
  models.md, and every language's examples, with Claude Opus 5 as the previous
  Opus; add "Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5" to shared/model-migration.md
- Add Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) as the current Sonnet, with
  Claude Sonnet 5 as the previous one, and update pricing, model-support
  callouts, and platform availability to match
- Add the build-eval and hillclimb flows under shared/evals/ (build-eval,
  eval-hillclimb, cost-hillclimb, eval-audit), the report schema, the lite HTML
  report builder, and the runner scaffold
- Add the preserved-thinking-migration subcommand with its cause reference and
  probe scripts, and note that drop_block can raise token usage
- Update cost-optimize f
author: rlancemartin
summary_zh: Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库更新了 claude-api skill：默认模型改为 Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5），新增 Claude Sonnet 5.5，并同步更新了价格、平台可用性和各语言示例，还补充了迁移到 Opus 5.5 的指南。另外新增 build-eval、eval-hillclimb、cost-hillclimb、eval-audit 等评测与迭代优化流程，附带报告 schema 和轻量 HTML 报告，可直接用于 LLM 应用的评测驱动开发。

title: v2.1.304
content: What's changed Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin Added decider: "person" to a mod's tool.check answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked Added e.isReadOnly to a mod's tool.check event, set when the tool call is read-only Added /auto-mode-setup : a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions Added /claude-api managed-agents-secure , which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O) Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share o
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.304 更新了 mod 的 hook 权限机制：新增 decider: "person"，要求必须由人工或宿主回调来批准；tool.check 事件新增 e.isReadOnly 字段，并在 hook 被跳过时写入记录。另外新增 /auto-mode-setup 引导式配置，会读取项目和近期会话来让 auto mode 了解环境，现已支持 Bedrock、Vertex 等平台。还新增了 /claude-api managed-agents-secure 命令，可对照官方安全指南检查 Managed Agents 的配置。

title: llm-echo 0.5
content:
Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning tokens into account. Example usage: uvx --with llm-echo llm -m echo 'hi there' -o thinking 1 --usage Outputs: First I consider the prompt, then I decide what to say.
{
  "prompt": "hi there",
  "system": "",
  "attachments": [],
  "stream": true,
  "previous": []
}
Token usage: 2 input, 24 output Tags: llm

title: My obituary for programming
content: My obituary for programming Jeremy Scheff poignantly captures the key loss caused by coding agents for career programmers who enjoyed the puzzle of developing code: Programming turned into one of the greatest jobs you could imagine. You got paid to work on tricky little logic puzzles. The trickier the puzzle, the more you got paid. But even pretty simple puzzles were worth a lot of money because regular people just couldn't do it! No, they needed us. They would give us a problem and we would solve it the way we wanted. We set the strategy, we made the timeline, we defined what was and was not possible. If you're a programmer who thrives on building working systems and doesn't care too deeply about the problems solved along the way, LLMs are the gift that keeps on giving. If directly solving those problems was a big part of your enjoyment, the loss is very real. Via lobste.rs Tags: programming , careers , ai , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , deep-blue
summary_zh: Simon Willison 引用了 Jeremy Scheff 的文章《我为编程写的讣告》。文章讲的是：对于喜欢解逻辑谜题、享受写代码过程的职业程序员来说，编程代理带走了这份工作中最有乐趣的部分。Simon 还对比了两类程序员：在乎做出可用系统的人会觉得 LLM 是持续不断的礼物，热衷亲手解决问题的人则会感到失落。这是一篇关于 AI 编程工具如何改变程序员职业认同的观点文章，可以引发思考，但不提供可操作的技巧。
